QF.id: AIFM CII Investment Process and Governance_41

question.text: Per the 'Industry Best Practices' section, the manager of a Cat I/II AIF should typically:

answer.text: Identify Key Persons / Key Executives of the fund and take Keyman Insurance as well as Indemnity Insurance
Rely only on verbal succession plans
Disclose key-person identities only after a vacancy arises
Avoid naming any key person in the PPM

explanation.text: **The Logic:** Industry best practice recommends identifying Key Persons / Key Executives and taking Keyman Insurance as well as Indemnity Insurance. Key Persons must inform investors of any situation substantially affecting their dedication to the Fund. **The Trap:** Verbal plans, hiding identities, and post-vacancy disclosure all violate transparency norms. **Cross-Exam Context:** XIX-C tests keyman-insurance best practice. **Manager's Pro-Tip:** Keyman + D&O insurance together typically cost 0.05-0.10% of AUM and dramatically reduce risk of investor litigation. Include the policy summary as an annexure to the PPM.
